Die Spielregeln eurer Runde: welche Wert: The rules of your group: which values a character has and how dice are rolled. Chronicles Lite, for example, is a ready-made rulebook.
Ein festgehaltener Stand eines Regelwerk: A fixed state of a rulebook, for example 1.0.0. Every change makes a new version; existing characters keep theirs until you switch.
Legt eine Version in die Bibliothek dein: Puts a version into your group's library, for example Chronicles Lite 1.0.0. It does not apply yet; for that you have to activate it.
Macht eine installierte Version zum Rege: Makes an installed version the rulebook you play by from now on, for example when moving to a new version. Existing sheets are carried over.
Ein Wert, den man auf dem Bogen einträgt: A value you fill in on the sheet, for example Strength 12 or the character's name.
Ein Wert, den das Regelwerk selbst ausre: A value the rulebook calculates itself, for example Defence = Agility + 10. You do not fill it in.
Ein Vorrat, der im Spiel sinkt und steig: A pool that goes down and up during play, for example Life 12 of 12. It shows as a coloured bar.
Ein Wurf nach festen Regeln, zum Beispie: A roll with fixed rules, for example “Strength check: 1d20 plus Strength, 15 or more succeeds”.
Etwas Besonderes, das eine Figur lernen: Something special a character can learn, for example “Mighty Blow”. Abilities can cost points and change values.
Etwas, das eine Figur gerade betrifft un: Something that affects a character right now and passes again, for example “Exhausted: −2 on all checks”.
Mehrere gleichartige Einträge auf dem Bo: Several entries of the same kind on the sheet, for example equipment with a name and weight for each item.
Das Blatt einer Figur mit allen Werten,: A character's page with all values, bars and abilities, for example as it appears at the table.
Ein Muster, aus dem du beliebig viele Fi: A pattern you create any number of characters from, for example “Town guard”. The template itself does not play.
Eine Person oder ein Wesen mit eigenem B: A person or creature with its own sheet, for example a player's heroine or an innkeeper run by the game master.
Der Wunsch von jemandem aus der Runde, e: Someone in the group asking to bring a character into play, for example with a name and values. The game master approves or declines it.
Du hast in dieser Runde noch keine Figur: You do not have a character in this group yet. Request one — the game master approves it, then you will find it under “Me”.
„{name}“ endgültig löschen? Die Vorlage: Delete “{name}” permanently? The template and all its versions disappear and cannot be brought back.
